description.narrative: The goal of the activity is to improve the enabling environment, access to fact-based independent sources of information, and sustainability, resilience and collaboration of civil society and media, to ensure that all citizens, especially youth and women, are included, engaged, and empowered to equitably lead the development of their communities and contribute to public discourse.
